FX-PTEX-001.says: Textured Square with no texture: a square about 9 pixels across in the Color Map's colour, a fifth of the way from yellow to red, unlit.

FX-PTEX-002.says: Textured Disc with no texture, D-610's size: D-610's Disc (FX-PSPACE-002).

FX-PTEX-003.says: Textured Faded Disc with no texture, D-610's size: D-610's Faded Sphere (FX-PSPACE-003).

FX-PTEX-004.says: Textured Square with the dot texture: its red, green, blue and white quarters, upright, the red one at the top left with a fainter pixel.

FX-PTEX-005.says: Textured Disc with the dot: the same quarters cut round.

FX-PTEX-006.says: Textured Faded Disc with the dot: the quarters fading to nothing at the edge.

FX-PTEX-007.says: Initial Rotation 360: the square turned by its own random amount.

FX-PTEX-008.says: Rotation Speed 90 a second: at 10.8 frames old, turned about 40 degrees clockwise.

FX-PTEX-009.says: Rotation Speed keyed from -180 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 24: read at the particle's birth (frame 9.2), so it turns anticlockwise at about 42 a second for life.

FX-PTEX-010.says: The 20 by 12 texture on the square: taken down between its second and third levels, so its blue checker greys.

FX-PTEX-011.says: A spread of turned textured squares at many depths: each read at its own level.

FX-PTEX-012.says: The big texture on the spread: the far ones greyer.

FX-PTEX-013.says: Depth Cue Fog towards blue, distance 3: the texture two thirds of the way to blue, its fainter pixel fainter blue.

FX-PTEX-014.says: Depth Cue Fade, distance 3: the texture at a third.

FX-PTEX-015.says: Two textured discs, Composite: the nearer over the farther.

FX-PTEX-018.says: The two over the drawing (Composite With Original on), Max Opacity 70.

FX-PTEX-019.says: The texture layer starting at frame 15: at frame 10 it has no picture, so nothing is drawn; at frame 20 it is FX-PTEX-005.

FX-PTEX-020.says: A texture layer not in the composition, `gone`: the effect is left out, the drawing shows, and the warning every frame.

FX-PTEX-021.says: FX-PTEX-004 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PTEX-022.says: The composition's camera, as added, on the spread.

FX-PTEX-023.says: A burst of turning textured squares, Rotation Speed 180 and Initial Rotation 360, at frames 12 and 24.

FX-PTEX-024.says: A tiny textured disc, size 1: drawn 1.4 pixels across and fainter, the texture taken down to its last levels.

FX-PTEX-025.says: A Disc (not textured) with the texture and rotation set: D-610's Disc, the texture not used (FX-PSPACE-002).

FX-PTEX-026.says: Particle Type "textured_polygon": not one of the eight. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PTEX-027.says: Rotation Speed 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PTEX-028.says: Initial Rotation -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PTEX-029.says: Initial Rotation 361, above 360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PTEX-030.says: A texture layer written as the number 3, not a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
